roleRulesDescription: Give a role to the members who have some roles, and take it when they do not anymore.
addDescription: Set the roles a member needs to get a role.
removeDescription: Remove the rule of a role, the members keep it.
listDescription: List the role rules of the server.
optionsRoleDescription: The role that is given and taken.
optionsRequiresDescription: A role the member must have.
optionsRequires2Description: Another role the member must have.
optionsRequires3Description: Another role the member must have.
optionsAnyOfDescription: The member must have at least one of the any-of roles.
optionsWithoutDescription: A role the member must not have.
optionsWithout2Description: Another role the member must not have.
noConditions: Give the rule at least one role the member must have or must not have.
everyone: Every member has @everyone, a rule cannot give or take it.
self: A rule cannot depend on the role it gives.
chained: {{role}} is given by a rule, or a rule depends on this role. Rules cannot depend on each other, they would never settle.
limit: The server already has the most role rules it can have.
added: Done: {{rule}}. The members get or lose the role the next time their roles change.
removed: The rule of {{role}} was removed, the members keep the role.
listEmpty: The server has no role rules. Add one with `/role-rules add`.
